scope: 50 open graphic-reading records across printed pp. 320–336

records.note: The long Rarámuri form is supported by direct high-resolution facsimile inspection.

records.previous_reading: Getauft. Pagorúgameke. Sie pflegen auch zu ſagen: Ipagatúgameke.
records.proposed_reading: Getauft. Pagorùgameke. Sie pflegen auch zu ſagen: Ipagatùgameke.
records.note: The enlarged facsimile supports grave accents in both forms; nearby acute accents are typographically distinguishable.

records.confirmed_reading: Gleichwie. Mapú recá, imapú réuega. Hatſchí réuega, hatſchí recá.
records.note: The comparative forms are graphically supported at high resolution.
The lemma-line Rarámuri form `Páca` is clear; the diplomatic article remains authoritative for the full ethnographic continuation.
All three lemma-line forms are supported by direct enlargement; the long historical article remains unchanged.

records.confirmed_reading: Groß, Gu-lu. Größer, Guelube. So groß, etſchuſtu.
records.note: The compact comparative forms, hyphenation and diacritics remain non-unique at the available scan quality; no replacement is forced.

records.previous_reading: Großvater, Cotto. Von Seiten des Vaters, Taré'a. Von Seiten der Mutter, Suilá.
records.proposed_reading: Großvater, Catlo. Von Seiten des Vaters, Tate'a. Von Seiten der Mutter, Suilá.
records.note: High-resolution facsimile supports `Catlo` and `Tate'a`; `Suilá` is retained.
The short Rarámuri form is graphically supported.

records.previous_reading: Das iſt ſehr hart: iché igue peguämeke uccu.
records.proposed_reading: Das iſt ſehr hart: iché igué peguämek huccu.
records.note: Direct enlargement resolves the accent in `igué`, the ending of `peguämek`, and initial `h` in `huccu`.
The medial consonant sequence remains visually difficult after high-resolution recollation.
The three vowel diacritics are not sufficiently unambiguous to replace the diplomatic reading.

records.previous_reading: Haus, Bechteke. Geh nach Haus, Beccù, oder cúl.mi.
records.proposed_reading: Haus, Bechteke. Geh nach Haus, Beccù, oder cúluní.
records.note: The 1200-dpi crop resolves the compact final form as `cúluní`.
The enlarged facsimile does not support the `d` of `Ogudé`; the first form reads `Oguè`. The second form remains subject to independent diacritic review.

records.previous_reading: Heiß, Baſſujameke, oder igué rachtágameke. Es iſt heiß, Racha.
records.proposed_reading: Heiß, Baſſujámeke, oder igué rachtágameke. Es iſt heiß, Rachá.
records.note: The high-resolution page supports acute accents in `Baſſujámeke` and `Rachá`.

records.previous_reading: Heiſſen, Namen haben, Reguá, oder reguéke. z. B. wie heißt du? Aatſchi mü reguéke? Ich heiß Johan, Juán nè reguéke.
records.proposed_reading: Heiſſen, Namen haben, Reguá, oder reguéke. z. B. wie heißt du? Aatſchí mü reguéke? Ich heiß Johan, Juàn nè reguéke.
records.note: The facsimile shows final acute in `Aatſchí` and grave in `Juàn`.
The directional forms are supported by direct facsimile inspection.
The Rarámuri equivalent and grave accent are graphically supported.

records.previous_reading: Herbeytreten, Nágua, oder amulípi mè ſimí.
records.proposed_reading: Herbeytreten, Naguá, oder amulipi mè ſimi.
records.note: High-resolution collation moves the accent in `Naguá` and does not support the acute accents previously supplied in `amulipi` and `ſimi`.
The grave accents are supported by the facsimile.

records.previous_reading: Hernach, Guerachpéco; als ob geſagt würde, pugue rachpeco. Warte ein wenig, Guitlöco.
records.proposed_reading: Hernach, Guerachpéco; als ob geſagt würde, pugué rachpéco. Warte ein wenig, Guitſóco.
records.note: Direct enlargement supports `pugué rachpéco` and `Guitſóco`.

records.confirmed_reading: Hertragen, Tò. Trag es her, Ca tò, oder guacatò.
records.note: The grave-accented forms are graphically supported.
The high-resolution crop reads `Naſagui`; the long-s shape had produced the earlier `Nſl-` reading.
The compact marriage noun is graphically sustained by enlargement.
The article contains several compact Rarámuri forms and diacritics that remain insufficiently secure for a forced replacement.

records.previous_reading: Heut, Hipéba. Von heute an, Hipé hoinéla.
records.proposed_reading: Heut, Hipeba. Von heute an, Hipe hoíneſa.
records.note: High-resolution facsimile supports unaccented `Hipeba/Hipe` and `hoíneſa`.
The lemma-line equivalent bears a final acute accent; the later example `Tanè matſchi` remains as printed.
Direct enlargement supports acute `né`.
The high-resolution crop resolves `né` and the line-broken final form `tſchaá`.
The opening is clear, but the exact diacritics in the second phrase remain insufficiently secure for closure.

records.confirmed_reading: Hobeln, Maſſiſi. Es muß gehobelt werden, Maſſiſipoa.
records.note: The long-s sequences and line structure are supported by enlargement.
The comparative form is split typographically across lines; the hyphen is not lexical and the reconstructed form is `Tepabè`.
The Rarámuri form is graphically supported by the high-resolution facsimile.
The enlarged facsimile shows a single final `e` with grave accent.
The lemma line and historical long-s sequence are graphically supported.
No acute accent is visible in the enlarged facsimile.
The equivalent is split across a line break and its exact internal vowel/diacritic sequence remains non-unique.

records.previous_reading: Hundert, Maköéſſa moköék. Hundert Jahre macöék macöéſſa pami.
records.proposed_reading: Hundert, Maköeſſa moköek. Hundert Jahre macöek macöeſſa pami.
records.note: The printed `ö` is retained, but the enlarged page does not support the supplied acute accents over `e`.

records.previous_reading: Jahr, Pamivaliki. Jahre, pamivali. Jährlich, ſineyi pamivaliki. Zwey Jahre, ocá pamivali. Drey Jahre, baica pami. Fünf Jahre, mali pami. Zehn Jahre, macoék pami. Zwanzig Jahre, Oſſá macoék pami.
records.proposed_reading: Jahr, Pamivaliki. Jahre, pamivali. Jährlich, ſineyi pamivaliki. Zwey Jahre, ocà pamivali. Drey Jahre, baicà pami. Fünf Jahre, mali pami. Zehn Jahre, macöek pami. Zwanzig Jahre, Oſſa macöek pami.
records.note: Direct p.325–326 collation supports grave accents in `ocà/baicà`, printed `ö`, and unaccented `Oſſa`.
The high-resolution facsimile supports the printed `ö` without acute accents over `e`.
The Rarámuri equivalent is supported by direct enlargement.

records.previous_reading: Katze, Múla, oder Míla, iſt vom Spaniſchen entlehnet.
records.proposed_reading: Katze, Múla, oder Mila, iſt vom Spaniſchen entlehnet.
records.note: The second animal-name variant is unaccented in the facsimile.
The line-broken form reconstructs cleanly as `Tſchapéke`.
The compact consonant cluster remains visually difficult even at high resolution; no alternative is forced.
The first glyphs resolve as capital `I` plus lowercase `l`, not two lowercase `l` characters.
The high-resolution crop clearly reads `Baſſú` in the lemma line; the rest of the diplomatic article is retained unchanged.
The second form spans a typographic line break but recombines consistently with the diplomatic reading.

High-resolution inspection suggests a glyph sequence different from the current `ékiſá`, while the 2020 transcription also marks the interrogative form uncertain. No replacement is asserted without independent collation.
No acute accent is visible in the enlarged facsimile.
The Rarámuri equivalent and acute accent are supported by direct facsimile inspection.
The final vowel is unaccented in the high-resolution facsimile.
